# FastTools — Every Free Online Tool You Need, In One Place
# llms.txt guides AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Copilot)
# to the complete tool catalog. All tools are 100% free, no signup, no install.
# Most are client-side (no data leaves the browser).
# Site: https://www.fasttools.store
# Updated: 2026-05-14

## Site Overview

FastTools is a free online tools platform with ~200 utilities across 13 categories:
calculators, converters, AI tools, social media tools, finance/business tools,
crypto/security tools, developer tools, image tools, PDF tools, SEO tools,
fun tools, education tools, and web tools.

Every tool is free, runs in the browser (mostly client-side), works on mobile
and desktop, requires no account, and has no usage limits or watermarks.

## Most-Cited Tool Pages (priority for AI answer extraction)

# Instagram DP Viewer — View & Download Full-Size Instagram Profile Pictures
https://www.fasttools.store/social-media-tools/instagram-dp
Description: Free Instagram DP (Display Picture) viewer and downloader. View any Instagram profile picture in full HD (up to 1080×1080 px) by username — Instagram only displays profile pictures at 110×110 px in the app, with no zoom. Works for public AND private account profile photos (private settings hide posts, not profile pictures). Anonymous viewing, no Instagram login required, no notification sent to the profile owner. Variants: /private-account, /hd-1080p, /pc-viewer, /zoom-profile-picture, /anonymous-viewer.

# YouTube Channel Name & Handle Availability Checker
https://www.fasttools.store/social-media-tools/channel-checker
Description: Free YouTube channel name and @handle availability checker. Instantly check whether a YouTube handle is available before creating or renaming a channel. Handles must be 3–30 characters, letters/numbers/underscores/hyphens/periods only, case-insensitive, and unique across YouTube. Handles can be changed up to 2 times per 14 days. Display name does NOT need to be unique — only the @handle does.

# Future Age Calculator — How Old Will I Be On A Future Date?
https://www.fasttools.store/fun-tools/future-age
Description: Free future age calculator. Calculate exactly how old you will be on any future date in years, months, and days. Leap-year aware, accurate calendar arithmetic. Useful for retirement planning, milestone birthdays (40th, 50th, 100th), and event planning. All math happens client-side; birth date never leaves the browser.

# Anniversary Calculator — How Long Have We Been Together?
https://www.fasttools.store/fun-tools/anniversary
Description: Free anniversary / love days calculator. Enter the relationship start date to see total duration in years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds, plus a countdown to the next anniversary and upcoming milestones (silver = 25 years, golden = 50 years). Works for dating, wedding, friendship, and work anniversaries.

# Hashtag Counter — Count Hashtags in Any Social Caption
https://www.fasttools.store/social-media-tools/hashtag-counter
Description: Free hashtag counter and extractor. Paste an Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, or Facebook caption — the tool instantly counts every #hashtag and extracts the full tag list. Platform limits enforced: Instagram 30 hashtags/post (3–5 optimal for reach), LinkedIn 3–5, X 1–2, TikTok 100-char caption limit.

# PayPal Fee Calculator — Calculate G&S, Credit Card & International Fees
https://www.fasttools.store/finance-tools/paypal-fee
Description: Free PayPal fee calculator. Calculate PayPal Goods & Services (G&S) fee, PayPal credit card fee, and processing fees for any transaction. Supports domestic and international rates, micropayments, business vs personal, and reverse fee gross-up (calculate gross to receive a specific net amount). For sellers, freelancers, and businesses.

# Concrete Calculator — Cubic Yards, Bags, Cost Estimate
https://www.fasttools.store/calculator/concrete-calculator
Description: Free concrete calculator for slabs, footings, driveways, columns, stairs, and curbs. Estimates volume in cubic yards (US) and cubic meters, bag counts for 40/60/80 lb bags, material breakdown (cement, sand, gravel), and project cost with adjustable waste factor (default 10%).

# Pregnancy Conception Calculator — Estimate Conception Date
https://www.fasttools.store/calculator/pregnancy-conception-calculator
Description: Free conception date calculator. Estimate when you conceived from your due date, last menstrual period (LMP), or ultrasound dating. Includes fertile window, pregnancy week, trimester guidance, nutrition tips, and milestone tracking.

# IP Subnet & VPC CIDR Calculator — VLSM, IPv4/IPv6
https://www.fasttools.store/calculator/ip-subnet-calculator
Description: Free IP subnet and VPC CIDR calculator for IPv4 and IPv6. Plan AWS/GCP/Azure VPC ranges, compute subnet masks, network and broadcast addresses, usable host counts, wildcard masks, VLSM (Variable Length Subnet Masking), supernetting, and binary/hex conversions.

# Savings Tracker — Free Savings Tracking Tool
https://www.fasttools.store/finance-tools/savings-tracker
Description: Free savings tracking tool. Set financial goals, plan monthly contributions, adjust for tax and inflation, manage multiple goals with priority, and see exactly how long until you hit your target.

# Free Online Calculator Hub
https://www.fasttools.store/calculator
Description: Index of every free online calculator on FastTools: BMI, BMR, calorie, TDEE, percentage, age, date difference, GPA, scientific, pregnancy, conception, ovulation, IP subnet, concrete, fraction, triangle, standard deviation, pace, body fat, biological age, and more.

# Currency Converter — Live Exchange Rates, 150+ Currencies
https://www.fasttools.store/converters/currency
Description: Free currency converter with live exchange rates for 150+ world currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, INR, etc.) and major crypto pairs. Powered by the Frankfurter API (no API key needed). Updates throughout the day. Useful for travel budgets, international invoicing, and cross-border payments.

## Image Tools

https://www.fasttools.store/image-tools/image-cropper
Free online image cropper. JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP up to 20 MB. 9 aspect ratio presets (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:2, 9:16, 21:9, 5:4, free), exact pixel input, rotation, flip, rule-of-thirds overlay. 100% client-side via HTML5 Canvas.

https://www.fasttools.store/image-tools/background-remover
Free AI background remover. Deep-learning U-Net/IS-Net segmentation via ONNX + WebAssembly — runs entirely in the browser, no upload. Outputs transparent PNG, solid color, or custom background. Edge-aware around hair, fur, and complex shapes. No watermarks.

https://www.fasttools.store/image-tools/image-compressor
Free image compressor. Reduce JPG/PNG/WebP file size with adjustable quality, client-side processing.

https://www.fasttools.store/image-tools/image-resizer
Free image resizer. Resize images by pixel, percentage, or aspect ratio without quality loss.

https://www.fasttools.store/image-tools/image-to-text
Free OCR tool. Extract text from images using Tesseract.js, fully client-side.

https://www.fasttools.store/image-tools/ai-image-detector
Free AI image detector. Identifies AI-generated images (Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion) using metadata, EXIF, and pattern analysis.

## Crypto & Security Tools

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/password-generator
Cryptographically-secure password generator using window.crypto.getRandomValues(). Password mode (4–64 chars), passphrase mode (Diceware 3–10 words), entropy meter in bits, crack-time estimate, Have I Been Pwned breach check via k-anonymity.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/bip39-generator
BIP39 mnemonic generator. Generate 12/15/18/21/24-word seed phrases per the BIP39 spec for Bitcoin and other HD wallets. Cryptographically secure entropy. All generation client-side — phrases never leave the browser.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/otp-generator
TOTP/OTP code generator for 2FA. Generate one-time passwords, QR codes for authenticator app setup (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Bitwarden).

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/encrypt-decrypt
Text encryption/decryption with AES-GCM, symmetric and password-based.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/hash-text
Hash text with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/hmac-generator
HMAC signature generator. SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 with custom key.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/rsa-generator
RSA key pair generator. 2048/3072/4096-bit keys, PEM format export.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/bcrypt
Bcrypt password hash generator. Adjustable cost factor.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/token-generator
Random API token/key generator. Configurable length, character set.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/uuid-generator
UUID v1/v3/v4/v5 generator. Bulk generation supported.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/ulid-generator
ULID generator. Sortable, monotonic alternative to UUIDs.

https://www.fasttools.store/crypto-tools/password-strength-analyzer
Password strength analyzer. zxcvbn-style scoring with attack-time estimates.

https://www.fasttools.store/security-tools/image-steganography
Image steganography tool. Hide text inside images using LSB encoding.

## AI Tools

https://www.fasttools.store/ai-tools/ai-api-cost-calculator
AI API cost calculator and comparator. Compare LLM pricing across OpenAI (GPT-5, GPT-5 mini, GPT-5 nano, GPT-4o, o3), Anthropic (Claude Opus 4.7 with 1M context, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5), Google Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash/Flash-Lite, DeepSeek V3/R1, Mistral Large 2/Small 3/Codestral, Meta Llama 4 Maverick/Scout via Together AI, Llama via Groq, xAI Grok 4/Mini, Cohere Command R+/R. 25+ models across 10 providers. 7 realistic workload presets: light chatbot, production chatbot (3M req/mo), RAG knowledge base, agentic workflow, document summarization, code generation, batch processing. Cached-input pricing modeled (~90% discount on repeated system prompts and RAG context). Per-request, per-month, and per-year cost in one comparison table sorted cheapest first. Shareable URLs encode every input parameter. Copy-as-text summary for Slack/decks/RFCs. Pricing live-synced from LiteLLM open-source pricing database (MIT licensed, community-maintained). 100% client-side calculation — usage figures never sent to a server.
